x: In the invitation 300 yards, Denis Merrett was our only representative, but after a very fast 200 yards, he slowed up and Wrighton proved himself the stronger and won in a time of 31.4s.

Alan Sexton made a welcome return in the 440 and finished second to Wrighton in the final. Jack Brown shook off all opposition except the great Gordon in the three miles dowing an excellent time of 14m. 48s.
Peter, taking advantage of the 'breaking-lane after first leg' rule, tucked behind Wrighton (Southgate) but found him just a little too strong at the finish.
